preconditions: Close the observation window and obtain a separate owner decision.
Rehash each candidate and its recovery source immediately before action.
Exclude every path referenced by a run manifest, latest pointer or rollback record.
Move candidates to a reversible quarantine before any later deletion decision.
retention_proposal.rollback: Restore the quarantined path from recovery_source and verify the recorded SHA-256.
retention_proposal.rule: Keep every published target and one verified recovery source per exact SHA-256 group.
